title: Amendment Trigger Matrix by Certificate: Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing
content:
Which changes to a certified fact require an amended Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate, by certificate type. "Yes" means the change requires an amended filing on that certificate; "No" means it does not.

| Certificate | Scheduled vehicle added, replaced or removed | Mailing address changed | New policy number | Legal name of the filed driver changed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal SR-22 Owner Certificate | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Cardinal SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner Certificate | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Cardinal FR-44 Owner Certificate | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Cardinal FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate | No | No | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the matrix

- **Vehicle changes** require an amended filing on the three owner certificates, the certificates that name the scheduled vehicles; the three owner-operator certificates do not name vehicles and take no vehicle amendment.
- **Mailing address changes** require an amended filing only on the two out-of-state certificates.
- **Policy number** and **legal name** changes require an amended filing on every certificate.

**Hypothetical reading.** A household holding a Cardinal FR-44 Owner Certificate that both replaces a car and moves house has one change marked Yes (the vehicle) and one marked No (the address) on its certificate. The household is invented for illustration.
